name: Given-name families
note: A name across languages: each family is one given name and every form a register or index wrote it as. Nothing about a person is kept here. Written only through scripts/given_name_variants.py.

statuses.same: One record, or the family's own tree, writes one person or family both ways.
statuses.attested: Met on a record of this family's line by the archive that read it.
statuses.rule: Reached by a documented mechanical substitution. No record needed.
statuses.lead: Plausible and never seen on a record. Search it; never write a data row on it alone.
statuses.case-by-case: Sometimes this family, sometimes another. Decide per record.
statuses.not-same: A different name that turns up in searches. Recorded so it is not decided twice.
statuses.slip: Written once by a clerk or an indexer by mistake. Not a spelling of the name; recorded so it is not mistaken for one.

rules.diacritic-fold: The index folds the mark: a search for one returns the other's records.
rules.translit: A documented substitution when a Slavic name crosses a Latin-alphabet border (ć written ch, š sh).
rules.latin-case: Latin declension: the register writes the name in the case the sentence needs (Joannem, Joannis).
rules.ending: A systematic ending change between languages (-schi / -ski, -ić / -ich).
